block.title: Zero-axiom Rocq proofs establish validator acceptance for the Gallina Pizlonator
block.p: Three zero-axiom Rocq proof modules under nanofil/rocq/backend now prove that Pizlonate.v turns every well-formed unchecked core-subset module into a checked-IR module that decodes under Transport.v and passes Validate.v. Makefile adds .pizlonate-assumptions to both all and proofs and verifies with Print Assumptions that every exported declaration across the three modules is Closed under the global context with no Runtime axioms.

PizlonatePollProof.v proves decimal-printer injectivity for Text.decimal, shows that Pizlonate.fresh with fuel equal to length names always finds an unused chk proof name with a strictly increasing counter, proves label_index uniqueness, proves that polled_jump preserves block successors, predecessors, and Cfg.block_intervals, and proves unconditionally in pizlonated_blocks_polls_every_cycle that every output function passes Validate.polls_every_cycle because all unpolled edges strictly increase block order.

PizlonateEvidenceProof.v defines the unchecked core-subset instruction syntax, decoder decode_umodule, and well-formedness predicate valid_unchecked_module. It proves term-to-syntax simulation between Pizlonate.checked_access, Pizlonate.flight_inst, and Transport.dinst across all twelve unchecked heap, atomic, vector-access, and stack-local forms plus indirect calls and pointer flights. Because every emitted capability check is consumed by the immediately following raw access, touch, or raw call, piz_func_evidence_pass discharges Validate.evidence_pass from arbitrary incoming live facts, piz_func_limit_reads discharges Validate.limit_reads, and step_uinst_valid_inst proves instruction typing.

PizlonateProof.v connects fresh-name disjointness, temporary-class preservation, monotone instruction-index mapping for strict SSA dominance and valid_locals, and module-level symbol, data, and alias preservation to prove pizlonate_module_stage_valid, pizlonate_module_valid, and pizlonate_module_checked_valid. Whenever an output module sets Validate.module_checked, the corollary delivers both conjuncts of Walk.checked_module, matching the precondition of Soundness.v. Sanity examples verify that concrete Fil-C loop and plain-mode integer modules satisfy valid_unchecked_module and discharge Validate.valid through the main theorem.

claim.p: The nanofil-backend Nix check compiles all three Pizlonation proof modules under pinned Rocq 9.1.1, enforces Closed under the global context via .pizlonate-assumptions, runs every backend regression gate, and passes web/rocq/tests/parse.sh grammar round-trip compilation across all backend .v files.
